classDiagram
    direction LR
    class Service["Payment service"] {
        <<service>>
        -String token
        +authorize(amount) bool
    }
    class List~T~
    class Isolated
    Base <|-- Service
    Interface <|.. Service
    Service "1" *-- "many" Record : owns
    Record o-- List~T~ : groups
    Service ..> Record : requests
    Service <--> List~T~ : exchanges
    Record .. List~T~ : observes
    Service --> Service : retry
